newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start cautiously higher after Dow record.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start cautiously higher after Dow record.

text.p: UK blue chips opened with a modest advance on Friday as investors took heart from Wall Street's record close overnight.
But the market is expected to remain on edge ahead of the release of U.S. December unemployment figures, due later this afternoon, dealers said.
"We've had a bit of a mark up but no one is rushing into buy ahead of the U.S. numbers," the head of trading at a large investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 index was up 3.9 points at 4,090.9 while the March FTSE futures contract rose 1.0 at 4,087 by 0835 GMT.
